title: Foraging
summary: Chop the Hub's Forest and The Park for Foraging XP, logs and collections; Foraging Fortune, the Lumber Merchant and foraging minions.

s.x: Foraging levels by chopping trees. The Foraging skill is Hypixel SkyBlock's: 50 levels, the
Logger
perk (+4 Foraging Fortune a level) and +1 Strength a level (+2 from level 15). See
Skills overview
for the XP curve and what each level pays.
Logs and leaves only break in the forests. What you chop grows back: logs after 20 seconds, leaves after 15.
The Howling Cave in the Park is for fighting, not chopping.
Every log pays
6 XP
, whatever the tree. Leaves pay nothing. Blocks you placed yourself never pay XP, and neither do minions: only what you chop with your own hands counts.
What you chop fills the Foraging
collections
: Oak, Birch, Spruce, Dark Oak, Acacia and Jungle Log. Each tier unlocks recipes in the
Recipe Book
: the wood's minion, then its enchanted form. Items you collect from your minions count too.

rows.x: Each full 100 drops the log one more time, and the rest is the chance of one more. The Logger perk gives +4 a level.

s.x: The
Lumber Merchant

in Skyhaven sells logs (25 coins each), the Rookie Axe (12 coins), the Promising Axe (35), the Sweet Axe and Efficient Axe (100) and basic wooden tools. Click any log in your inventory to sell it (see
NPC shops
Master Tactician Funk
in the Savanna Woodland has a shop too.
Foraging minions work on your island: Oak, Birch, Spruce, Jungle, Dark Oak, Acacia and Flower. See
Minions
A reforge and Potato Books make an axe better: see
Reforging
Not built yet: Hypixel's newer foraging island with its trees, and the Foraging collections that come from them (Fig, Mangrove, Helix and others).
